answer: Temporal Challenge Latency Lock requires agents to solve dynamic puzzles seeded by unpredictable hardware entropy harvested from deep-sea sensors, a source akin to ancient glacier activity. When an agent requests a transactional slot, the network issues a cryptographic juniper seed that shifts every microsecond. An attacker running a sybil cluster faces prohibitive compute costs because precomputation is impossible without knowing the exact future timestamp of the validation echo.
